research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Turo is researching systems and methods for filtering vehicle search results for an upcoming trip, as described in Filtering vehicle search results for an upcoming trip. These developments involve a vehicle access platform that processes search queries and incorporates an adverse outcome prediction engine to enhance the vehicle selection process. The focus is on optimizing how users discover and access vehicles, highlighting advancements in search filtering and risk assessment for car-sharing.

overview_description.description: Turo operates a peer-to-peer car-sharing marketplace that allows travelers to rent vehicles from local hosts. The platform connects car owners with renters, facilitating a diverse selection of cars at competitive prices. This model enables owners to earn income while providing convenient access to vehicles for travelers in their communities.

about_short_description.short_description: Turo is a peer-to-peer car-sharing marketplace where customers can book vehicles from a community of local hosts.

product.name: Turo Car-Sharing Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace and mobile app that connects vehicle owners with travelers and local drivers who want to book cars for periods ranging from a day to a month.

product.name: Vehicle Hosting and Listing Service
product.description: A service that lets vehicle owners list eligible cars on Turo, set pricing and availability, manage bookings, communicate with guests, and earn income from vehicle sharing.

product.name: Guest Vehicle Rentals
product.description: A booking service for renting community-owned vehicles for road trips, local transportation, business travel, special events, moving, outdoor activities, and vehicle test drives.

identifier.value: Host Earnings Plans and Vehicle Protection

product.name: Host Earnings Plans and Vehicle Protection
product.description: Host plans that combine third-party liability coverage with contractual reimbursement for eligible physical damage to vehicles shared through Turo, with different revenue shares and damage responsibilities.

product.name: Host Hub
product.description: A resource and business-management center that provides hosting guides, operational tools, tax resources, earnings-plan information, and guidance for growing a Turo vehicle-sharing business.

product.name: Turo Carculator
product.description: An online earnings and return-on-investment estimation tool that helps prospective and existing hosts compare vehicles and evaluate their potential performance on Turo.
